message.content: {"B_expression":"-1/(2*(1+u)**3*(sqrt(1+r/(1+u)**2)+1)**2)","C_expression":"-1/(2*(1+u))","derivation":"Retain the generation-1 program unchanged for the P06_s1_W2 stage. The exact increment is g_exact = r/((1+u)*(sqrt(1+r/(1+u)^2)+1)); expanding in r gives g_exact = r/2 - u*r/(2(1+u)) - r^2/(2(1+u)^3*(sqrt(1+r/(1+u)^2)+1)^2) + O(r^3), identifying C = -1/(2(1+u)) and B as stated. Smoothness on an open neighbourhood of the closed rectangle |r|<=1/2, |u|<=1/4 follows because 1+u >= 3/4 and 1 + r/(1+u)^2 >= 17/25 > 0 throughout, keeping the square-root argument strictly positive and all denominators nonzero. The analytic certificate status ANALYTIC_ON_CORE_NEIGHBORHOOD was issued in the prior generation and remains valid. The generation-1 numerical feedback confirmed machine-epsilon residuals (~1e-71) for all in-support UNIFORM rows and correct chi-gating for out-of-support edge rows. The next stage (tau^2 increment) will present smaller |r| values (order tau^2 = 1/4096 to 1/16384) for the in-support families, where the same cancellation applies with even smaller arguments.
